title: Migration 36 — Public intake hardening (rate-limited server path)
description: Applies migration 34 (the intake table this migration hardens) then migration 36, runs VERIFY A-H, and rolls back 36 then 34. Migration 34 is an apply stage rather than substrate because 36's whole purpose is to change 34's policy and grant posture — shimming it would test the shim, not the migration.

verify.note: A-D are read-only catalog/privilege checks and are safe against Production. C is the finding itself (no anon-satisfiable write policy and no anon INSERT grant remain). D asserts what migration 36 must NOT have touched, including migration 34's deliberate absence of a DELETE policy. G is the atomic throttle reservation (Codex P1) and H is the literal duplicate lookup (Codex P2); both are behavioural and roll back.
